result.title: CrossFit-GS: Out-of-Fold Pose Estimation for COLMAP-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
result.summary: Pose-free 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) aims to bypass cumbersome Structure-from-Motion (SfM) by directly reconstructing scenes from unposed image sequences. In this work, we present CrossFit-GS, a deferred-commitment progressive framework that mitigates cumulative trajectory drift and breaks the self-reinforcing loop of distorted-map error propagation. Specifically, we partition the input sequence into interleaved subsets and maintain two complementary submaps. Each candidate pose is cross-refined against a frozen opposite submap that has never been optimized using the target frame, thereby providing an independent geometric reference for pose estimation. Checkerboard validation and spatial coverage safeguards further reject unreliable updates, and only verified poses are committed to their corresponding owner submap. Once the trajectory has been refined, the intermediate submaps are discarded and the final global representation is trained from scratch using the fixed refined poses. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that CrossFit-GS substantially reduces cumulative trajectory drift and consistently improves both camera pose estimation and novel-view synthesis over existing methods.

AI.brief_summary: CrossFit-GS 提出免位姿的 3DGS 重建框架：把输入序列划为交错子集并维护两个互补子图，候选位姿先与「从未用该帧优化过」的冻结对侧子图交叉精化，再经棋盘验证与空间覆盖检查，仅提交通过检验的位姿，最后以固定位姿重训全局表示。
AI.relevance_reason: 用冻结的互补子图作为独立几何参照来筛选并提交更新、抑制误差自增强，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的验证式提交、视觉证据筛选与停止判断提供方法线索，需核查该类比的可迁移性。
